items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And there was just one of them… Mr. Anderson tells me the man that lived next door to me was a white gentleman that lived in the neighborhood and he said the poker games on Saturday with Babe Ruth, and Fats Waller, and Earl Stanley, they was just marvelous.

ctx.x: Fats Waller was right down the street here. He got his house when two guys got to arguing about something in the neighborhood and they say well they‟ll break up the neighborhood, they‟ll sell their house to a black man. The guy said there‟s no black man that got enough money to buy the house and Fats Waller… he sold it to Fats.
